description: Ensure the entire frame path from DXGI/WGC capture to encoder submission stays on the GPU — no CPU readback. DXGI DD delivers ID3D11Texture2D; that texture must be registered as an encoder input resource (NVENC NV_ENC_REGISTER_RESOURCE / AMF AMFSurface / QSV mfxFrameSurface1) without copying to system memory. Includes shared D3D11 device management so capture and encoder use the same device context. Benchmark: verify zero memcpy in frame path via GPU profiling.
title: Zero-copy GPU frame pipeline (capture → encode)
